title: AutoX Fully Driverless RoboTaxi in Urban Villages #AutoXRoboTaxi
summary: AutoX shows its fully driverless robotaxi navigating dense, chaotic urban village streets in Chinese cities. The vehicle nudges through crowds, bikes, scooters and pets.
why: Cited as evidence that Chinese robotaxis handle difficult edge cases in self-driving debates.

quote.text: AutoX has some of the best edge case handling I've seen.
